title: Make public transport accessible under the disability standards
what: Operators of public transport services (aircraft, buses and coaches, ferries, taxis, trains and trams), and providers of their premises and infrastructure, must meet the Disability Standards for Accessible Public Transport. Contravening a disability standard is unlawful.

laws.title: Disability Standards for Accessible Public Transport 2002

sources.title: Disability Standards for Accessible Public Transport 2002
sources.quote: (2) These Standards apply to all operators and the conveyances they use to provide public transport services. They also apply to providers and supporting premises and infrastructure.

sources.title: Disability Discrimination Act 1992
sources.quote: 32 Unlawful to contravene disability standards It is unlawful for a person to contravene a disability standard.

marks.reason: Accessible conveyances, boarding equipment and premises, which operators must fund and maintain.
